references.text: A powerful theological contrast: From weeping over a lack of blessing (Gen 27:38) to saying 'I have enough' and giving gifts away (Gen 33:9), showing Esau's change of heart.
Theological parallel: Isaac confirms that Jacob has received all he needs (Gen 27:37), while Esau later affirms that he himself has enough (Gen 33:9), resolving the conflict over the inheritance.
Contrast between false identity ('It is I' in deception, Gen 27:24) and true reconciliation where the brothers meet as they truly are (Gen 33:9).
